entries.en: Hop on up.
How'd you imagine this date going?
entries.ro: Cum ți-ai imaginat că merge întâlnirea asta?

entries.en: So that's how you do it.
Oh, so that's how you do it.
Rogue. I don't need this world anymore.
entries.ro: Rogue. Nu mai am nevoie de lumea asta.

entries.en: But I need you.
Johnny. I was wrong about you.
entries.ro: Johnny. M-am înșelat în legătură cu tine.

entries.en: This how you imagined this evening goin'?
And it's a cryin' shame.
Always knew things would have to change for us to just go out and catch a movie.
entries.ro: Mereu am știut că trebuie să se schimbe ceva ca să ieșim la un film.

entries.en: Never imagined they'd change this much.
entries.ro: Nu mi-am imaginat niciodată că o să se schimbe atât de mult.

entries.en: Sure. Lured you to the movies to get laid, by the way.
entries.ro: Sigur. Te-am ademenit la film ca să mă culc cu tine, apropo.

entries.en: Let's pretend it's twenty-fifteen, huh?
entries.ro: Hai să ne prefacem că e 2015, da?

entries.en: I like the Rogue of 2077.
We just met, an' I got no idea what a bastard you are.
entries.ro: Ne-am cunoscut abia acum și n-am nicio idee ce nenorocit ești.

entries.en: Sure. Lured you to the movies so we could bang, by the way.
entries.ro: Sigur. Te-am târât la film ca să ne culcăm, apropo.

entries.en: Hahaha.
It's technically a possibility, you know.
But I like twenty-seventy-seven Rogue .
A far inferior version.
OK, so it's twenty-fifteen. If you could do it all again, what would you change? Anything at all?
entries.ro: Bine, deci e 2015. Dacă ai putea s-o iei de la capăt, ce-ai schimba? Orice?

entries.en: Nope. Never did anything I wouldn't do again.
entries.ro: Nu. N-am făcut niciodată ceva ce n-aș mai face.

entries.en: I'd kill Smasher.
Do anything not to lose you.
entries.ro: Aș face orice să nu te pierd.

entries.en: Think I'd do Kerry.
entries.ro: Cred că m-aș culca cu Kerry.

entries.en: Yeah – I'd do Kerry.
Huh?
I'd do everything in my power not to lose you.
entries.ro: Aș face tot ce pot ca să nu te pierd.

entries.en: I'd get Smasher before he got me. And maybe plant more charges in that tower.
entries.ro: L-aș prinde pe Smasher înainte să mă prindă el. Și poate aș planta mai multe încărcături în turnul ăla.

entries.en: Nope. Doesn't work that way. All those braincraps, dopey decisions, they were wholly mine.
entries.ro: Nu. Nu merge așa. Prostiile alea, deciziile alea proaste, au fost toate ale mele.

entries.en: So you'd get yourself killed again.
Over an obsession with Arasaka, for someone who wasn't a real person.
entries.ro: Din cauza unei obsesii cu Arasaka, pentru cineva care nu era om de fapt.

entries.en: So you'd do the exact same thing just better?
entries.ro: Deci ai face exact același lucru, doar mai bine?

entries.en: Johnny, I...
I mean, guy deserved it. Always tryin' so damn hard.
entries.ro: Adică, tipul a meritat. Mereu se chinuia atât de tare, fir-ar.

entries.en: Fucking hell, Johnny. I was being serious.
Hey, hey, hey, what's this?
Nothing, it's just... Had a lot of time to think while you were away.
entries.ro: Nimic, doar că... Am avut mult timp să mă gândesc cât ai fost plecat.

entries.en: What ifs and all that.
That's it? It's not about Grayson?
entries.ro: Asta e tot? Nu e despre Grayson?

entries.en: Only thing that matters is I came back to you.
entries.ro: Singurul lucru care contează e că m-am întors la tine.

entries.en: All that counts is I'm back – with you.
entries.ro: Tot ce contează e că m-am întors – la tine.

entries.en: Sure that's it, nothing about Grayson or Smasher?
entries.ro: Sigur că asta e tot, nimic despre Grayson sau Smasher?

entries.en: Got a feeling you're not telling me something.
Getting the sense you still got a thorn in your side there.
entries.ro: Mi se pare că încă ai un ghimpe în coastă.

entries.en: What? What's Smasher gotta do with anything?
entries.ro: Ce? Ce legătură are Smasher cu asta?

entries.en: 'Cause I do. I'm irate, disappointed. But rather not think about it now.
entries.ro: Pentru că da. Sunt furios, dezamăgit. Dar mai bine nu mă gândesc acum.

entries.en: Think you might be hidin' somethin' from me.
Johnny, there's a heap of things I'm hiding from you.
entries.ro: Johnny, am o grămadă de lucruri pe care ți le ascund.

entries.en: [Kiss] More than I expected.
Don't got much to offer you.
Don't got much to offer you.
It's more than I ever could've asked for.
entries.ro: E mai mult decât aș fi putut cere vreodată.

entries.en: Still more than before.
Think that's way better than any "what if."
entries.ro: Cred că e mult mai bine decât orice „și dacă”.

entries.en: But all we got's this one night.
entries.ro: Dar tot ce avem e noaptea asta.

entries.en: Rogue, I'm here on borrowed time, in a borrowed body. But I'm here.
entries.ro: Rogue, sunt aici pe timp împrumutat, într-un corp împrumutat. Dar sunt aici.

entries.en: Johnny, I can't.
It's not right.
You mean towards V?
I get it.
Thought this is what you wanted.
I know, I fucked up back then. See it now.
entries.ro: Știu, am futut-o atunci. Acum văd.

entries.en: I... can't.
See what you're trying to do, but... I'm in a different place now.
entries.ro: Văd ce încerci să faci, dar... am trecut peste asta.

entries.en: Meanin' not fair to V?
entries.ro: Adică nu e corect față de V?

entries.en: I understand.
Thought you wanted this.
Not fair to you.
No, you don't.
Because I did.
Tried so hard to pretend nothing's changed. To pretend I'm the same Rogue you knew.
entries.ro: Am încercat din răsputeri să pretind că nimic nu s-a schimbat. Că sunt aceeași Rogue pe care o știai.

entries.en: Actually managed to fool myself for a little.
entries.ro: Chiar am reușit să mă păcălesc o vreme.

entries.en: Guess it didn't go well…?
Rogue's gone…
Yep.
What'd you get into a fight about?
Guess things did not go swimmingly…
entries.ro: Bănuiesc că n-a mers tocmai bine…

entries.en: You fought – what about?
Movie was a turd wrapped in crepe paper.
entries.ro: Filmul a fost un rahat învelit în hârtie creponată.

entries.en: Uhhh...
Grabbed us the best spot.
entries.ro: Am prins cel mai bun loc.

entries.en: Got no idea what you're talkin' about.
entries.ro: N-am nicio idee despre ce vorbești.

entries.en: I know. An' I'd rather it stayed that way.
entries.ro: Știu. Și mai bine rămâne așa.

entries.en: Let's just watch the movie.
entries.ro: Hai să ne uităm la film.

entries.en: See I coulda been myself around you. Only you. No pretending, no posing.
entries.ro: Vezi, cu tine aș fi putut să fiu eu. Doar eu. Fără prefăcătorie, fără pozat.

entries.en: Johnny...
I say something wrong?
No idea what you're talking about.
Was it something I said?
No. You're just too late. The Rogue you knew is gone.
entries.ro: Nu. Ai ajuns prea târziu. Rogue pe care o cunoșteai s-a dus.

entries.en: An' I don't wanna keep pretending otherwise.
entries.ro: Și nu mai vreau să mă prefac că nu e așa.

entries.en: Nope.
Ugh. Got no idea.
Was gonna be a nice night at the drive-in.
entries.ro: Trebuia să fie o seară faină la drive-in.

entries.en: Now she's mad. And won't tell me what about.
entries.ro: Acum e supărată. Și nu-mi spune de ce.

entries.en: Any guesses?
Maybe it's you. Maybe she just lost interest.
entries.ro: Poate ești tu. Poate și-a pierdut interesul.

entries.en: Any guesses?
Maybe it's just you. Maybe she just lost interest.
entries.ro: Poate ești tu. Poate și-a pierdut interesul.

entries.en: Uh, no. It's definitely not me.
'Member Grayson, how they spoke, how weird it was?
entries.ro: Ții minte de Grayson? Cum vorbea, ce ciudat era?

entries.en: Weird's not the word, I don't think. He was toying with 'er. Could be something to that.
entries.ro: Ciudat nu-i cuvântul potrivit. Se juca cu ea. Poate că e ceva la mijloc.

entries.en: Gotta mull it over. For now, take me to North Oak.
entries.ro: Trebuie să mă gândesc. Deocamdată, du-mă în North Oak.

entries.en: That s'posed to help you figure out Rogue?
entries.ro: Asta ar trebui să te ajute s-o înțelegi pe Rogue?

entries.en: No – Kerry. Tell you once we're there.
entries.ro: Nu – Kerry. Îți spun când ajungem.

entries.en: Rogue!
Fuck.
That how you're gonna leave it?
Better this way. Take care, Johnny.
entries.ro: Așa e mai bine. Ai grijă, Johnny.

entries.en: [Take pills]
[Kiss] More than I expected.
I don't have much to offer.
Hehh. Get back on my own.
Havin' a good time?
Hm, takin' a while to mull that one over…
entries.ro: Hm, încă mă gândesc la asta…

entries.en: Johnny...
